observations: All 24 new symbols show visible ink in both actual TTF styles and both themes at 14 CSS px; solid and hollow pairs retain distinct interiors.
Navigation directions and the new U+2039 / existing U+203A pair remain distinct in the HUD; no obvious baseline or optical-center jump in the sampled lines.

The box frames join at the current font advance and hhea line height without hard background gaps; native DPR1 antialiasing produces faint per-cell seams and colored edge pixels, visible in integer zoom.
DPR2 retains the same layout and has smoother small shape edges. Auxiliary 11-14px rows are samples, not a universal readability guarantee.
limits: Actual WAO Flutter/Android layout and rasterization remain to be accepted in that application.

integer_enlargement.method: nearest-neighbor from native DPR1 surface crops
